answer: The north island banding station will not issue a second glove to a stack of new names. A handler posts one onyx ring whose inner diameter, measured at 17°C, is 16.20 to 16.40 millimeters, then keeps a tagged falcon on the scale for 25 seconds while the mass holds between 612.0 and 618.0 grams. A reused ring serial, a diameter miss past 0.05 millimeters, or a second bird burns the 30.4 POA bond and closes that glove for five days.
